line 12: “A woman must have money and a room of her own if she is to write fiction.”  - Virginia Woolf
line 13: To be honest, it was only when I was in Morocco this year that I really saw it. line 14: Obviously I’ve painted in lots of makeshift spaces, from China to theatres to all sorts of different locations, so I’m used to working with a few things, making the best of it and keeping it moving.
